El canal de notificación está operativo
Se asume que 'Party Reference Data Directory' es el propietario de los datos de contacto (celular y correo electrónico) y permite su edición/actualización directa.

Se asume que el mecanismo de seguridad 'Smart Token' se evalúa y valida dentro del flujo de 'Party Authentication' o 'Transaction Authorization' para mitigar el riesgo de la transacción de actualización.
gaps: No se especifican los criterios exactos de validación de datos
No se describen los mensajes de error o confirmación en la UI
No se indica el método exacto de notificación (push, email, SMS)
No se detallan requisitos de rendimiento o disponibilidad

No se detalla en el catálogo un Service Domain exclusivo para la validación de formato o existencia de datos de contacto (servicio de validación de datos de contacto), por lo que se asume que esta lógica es provista de manera interna por el dominio que administra los datos de la parte o por un utilitario de sistemas.

candidatos_directos.accion_objeto: actualizar número celular y correo electrónico
candidatos_directos.justificacion: La historia requiere visualizar y actualizar datos de contacto del cliente. El Service Domain ofrece operaciones RetrieveReference y UpdateReference sobre el schema Reference que contiene eMailAddress y CellPhoneNumber. El Service Role describe la mantención de datos de referencia de contacto, alineándose con el objeto funcional.
candidatos_directos.rol_bian: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data that might be used in any interaction between the bank and the party including relationship development, sales/marketing, servicing and product delivery. This can include general reference and contact details, party associations, demographic details and some servicing preferences. Different information may be maintained for different party types such as individuals, corporates, partners

escenarios_hu: Escenario 1 - Ingresar a la pantalla de datos personales
operaciones_bian.justificacion: Permite recuperar los datos de referencia del cliente, incluyendo nombre, identificación, número de celular y correo electrónico para mostrarlos en la pantalla de perfil.
operaciones_bian.bq_seed: visualizar mi información básica y mis datos de contacto

observaciones_adversariales: [adversarial] El Service Domain esta configurado para actualizar datos, pero la historia de usuario solo requiere visualizar la pantalla de datos personales y acceder a la edicion.
assumptions: UpdateReference permite modificar los campos de correo y celular del cliente.

candidatos_descartados.accion_objeto: visualizar datos personales como usuario autenticado
candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia requiere que el usuario esté previamente autenticado para acceder a la pantalla de datos personales. Party Authentication actúa como un guard de seguridad (dependencia consumida) y no administra directamente el ciclo de vida de los datos de contacto o personales del cliente.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: Customer/party authentication is a cross-channel/device capability that provides identity confirmation for customers accessing the bank through any interactive channel. The service may use a combination of one or more mechanisms to authenticate including issued tokens/devices, virtual mechanisms such as passwords and biometrics such as voice/face recognition. Different levels of authentication may be determined to support different types of access and there may be access permissions associated with the authentication mechanism used
assumptions: Se asume que la autenticación del usuario es un prerrequisito ya resuelto por la plataforma antes de renderizar la pantalla de datos personales.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia trata de ver y editar datos personales de contacto; el dominio Correspondence solo gestiona generación y seguimiento de correspondencia, sin operaciones que administren pantalla de datos personales ni actualicen información de contacto. Por lo tanto no hay ownership ni consumo directo.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain handles the automated generation of (batches of) pre-formatted correspondence. It also handles the tracking of expected responses to sent out mail requests and handles the matching of the response and the onward routing of these and all unsolicited inbound correspondence.
gaps: Ausencia de operaciones o esquemas que manejen datos personales o pantalla de datos personales.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: No operation or schema in Internal Audit matches the verbs or objects of the user story. The service domain deals with audits, not personal data screens.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain administers the scheduled and ad-hoc application of internal audit and compliance reviews. This includes interpreting the banks policies and procedures that guide all aspects the bank's operations and determining which guidelines apply in specific circumstances across the enterprise. Support for interpreting guidelines are provided to activities in the bank that are subject to audit and scheduled and ad-hoc checks performed to confirm compliance

service_domains_omitidos.rol_bian: The Customer Agreement service domain captures and maintains the master legal terms of conditions in force for a customer (which as noted can be a complex multinational with many underlying product and service specific agreements).

This service domain provides a general customer billing service. The service domain is provided with the applicable fees and charges that are authorized for invoicing typically by a product or service fulfillment service domain. Processing can include verification and authorizations steps and the invoice could be issued as a single transaction or a schedule of transactions.

Case resolution tasks follow specific procedures for the type of case involved. Case resolution can be quick by applying resolution rules and obtaining additional authorization as necessary, or they can be long living activities, for example where documentation is requested and has to be retrieved from merchants or other interested parties before the disputed issue can finally be ruled upon. A wide range of case types can be expected

This service domain administers customer consents for their preferences and constraints on accepting direct debit collection requests, request to pay against their accounts held at the bank, or preferences for credit transfer (e.g. payment rail, preferred funding account, etc.)

The Offer Management Service Domain can process offers for all types of customers and any allowed combination of product or service. It references the Product Directory for the product specific offer instructions it must follow. The offer process may combine the selection of product/service specific details (e.g. pricing & negotiation ranges, documentation/authorization/regulatory requirements, eligibility and declarations, credit and other customer details), customer specific details (e.g. credit standing, other classifications such as operational overhead/retention target/activity history, demographics and segmentation). The service domain orchestrates a potentially complex/multi-threaded/multi stage workflow to get the offer to the point where the product/service can be initiated.
